pipeline: BERTimbau opportunity classifier -> meeting aggregation -> multilingual_e5_small -> grounded structured insight

aggregation.decision: minimum count and density of high-probability chunks
aggregation.support: maximum and mean of top 3 chunk probabilities
aggregation.conflict: candidate meeting with at least two chunks <= 0.20

warning: Thresholds are operational heuristics. End-to-end metrics and production selection require human meeting labels.
